🚨 Saddening news: A 29-year-old mother was found hanging from a tree in Mississippi. The circumstances surrounding Tasia Fortune's death are currently being investigated. She is the third person found hanging in Mississippi in less than a year. The other two deaths were ruled suicides.
@MimiBrownTV breaks down the details in today's Front Page News.
posts.summary: Raises concerns about pattern of suspicious hanging deaths in Mississippi
